Question 1
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in ft/s2, given by the function a(t)=6t2−4t3, where t is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity v=−5ft/s when t=2s, find the velocity (in ft/s) of the particle at time t.

a
v(t)=2t3−t4+3
b
 v(t)=3t2−t3−9
c
 v(t)=3t3−2t4+3
d
v(t)=2t3−t4−5
e
 v(t)=6t3−4t4+11
